content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your highest degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess your background against PMI standards before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all sessions synchronously with experienced instructors, ask questions in real time, and receive verified contact-hour documentation upon completion—a prerequisite for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute using your course completion certificate. Submit your formal application, including education and experience verification, and pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI's application review process before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to the Rockford area, and take the assessment under proctored conditions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, workshops, and volunteer service. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing resources to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
